description: A React component implementing an attachments management dialog for the Notesnook project, including attachment listing, filtering, sorting, and actions like download, check, delete, with associated UI components and state management.

classes.name: AttachmentsDialog
classes.description: Main React component for managing and displaying attachments in a dialog, with filtering, sorting, and batch actions.

methods.name: AttachmentRow
methods.description: Renders individual attachment row within the virtualized table, resolving item data and rendering Attachment component.

methods.name: getCounts
methods.description: Fetches counts of attachments per category from the database.

methods.name: filterAttachments
methods.description: Returns a database query for attachments filtered by route/category.
